data.summary_en: We propose CausalEvo, which fixes model weights, feedback cases, and the number of rules, uses paired skill replacement to estimate relative skill effects, and retains top-ranked rules; on 120 held-out cases from MedCalc-Bench-Verified, it achieves 60.00% accuracy, exceeding SkillOpt's 55.83% and 51.67% without skills.
